problemStatement: Users want a QR code for a short link so it can be printed or shown on screens.

functional.text: GET /api/v1/links/{code}/qr returns a PNG QR code encoding the link's short URL.
An optional size parameter sets the image width and height, from 128 to 1024 pixels, default 256.
The endpoint respects link status: unknown, deleted or disabled links return 404 problem details.

nonFunctional.text: A QR code renders in under 50 ms at the p95 for the default size.

acceptanceCriteria.then: 200 with Content-Type image/png that decodes to the short URL
400 problem details naming the allowed range

assumptions: The QR code encodes the public short URL, not the destination.

ambiguities.question: Should SVG be offered as well as PNG?

outOfScope: Logos or colours inside the QR code
